title: MuSTNet: SAT-based Exact Multi-Stage Transistor Network Synthesis with Placement Awareness
problem: Complex gate synthesis typically focuses on single-stage networks, neglecting multi-stage opportunities and transistor placement, limiting optimization potential.
method: The approach uses a SAT solver (a constraint-satisfaction engine that finds exact optimal solutions) to design transistor networks. Rather than optimizing one layer of logic gates at a time, it considers multiple layers together, revealing deeper optimization opportunities. Critically, it accounts for physical transistor placement on the chip—not just logical correctness—enabling simultaneous reduction of both transistor count and chip area.
key_novelty: This is the first SAT-based method that optimizes transistor networks across multiple stages while directly accounting for physical transistor placement on the chip.
contributions: Multi-stage hierarchy for deeper functional optimization
21.4% area reduction vs traditional cell-level design
